title: Coconut flour bread
preamble:
1/2 cups ghee (or butter)

1-2 tablespoon honey, depending on taste

1/2 teaspoon sea salt

1 teaspoon baking powder

3/4 cup coconut flour
method: Preheat your oven to Gas Mark 4.
Whisk it all together, or blend in a food processor until all lumps are gone.
Grease a bread pan with butter or coconut oil and pour your batter in.
notes: If we split it up into six servings each slice will, according to FitDay, have:
30.9 g fat 13.2 g carbs (9 g fiber) 8.35 g protein
